stage: 3B — close every remaining Track 1 blocker, or turn it into a hard code gate

verdict.label: ONLY USER_DECISION_GATE REMAINS
verdict.summary: Four blockers closed with code and a test that goes red when the code is removed. Four are held by a decision only the project owner can make, each enforced by a hard code gate that refuses to arm the order path until an explicit schema-checked confirmation exists on disk. There is no OPEN status: track1_gates allows exactly two, and a self-check refuses a gate nothing can release, a CLOSED blocker that still blocks, and a CLOSED blocker with no evidence.

decisions_needed.decision: One IB Gateway login is one position book. Retire legacy first — the stated end state and the cheaper of the two — or fund a dedicated IBKR account for Track 1.

The Normal-R4 generator reproduces the committed rows exactly but replaces five production symbols while it runs and depends on a root-level script. Accept subprocess isolation, or fund a real promotion into futures/ with its own equivalence proof.

Calm A's setup list is a frozen CSV; the detector exists as prose and a column, not a function. Write it with a test that reproduces the CSV row for row, or accept that Calm A is replay-only and can never fire live.

Scheduling Track 1 slots changes what a running production process does. Approve when the slots, the schedule_status mirror, the _ENTRY_WINDOWS entry for 10:35-12:30 and the route-field policy are all to be applied together.

carried_state_finding.title: what Stage 2C could not prove is now proved — the cut was the problem, not the field
carried_state_finding.correction: Stage 2D Addendum 1 stated that Stage 2C had proved risk and cluster load-bearing. That was taken from a handoff and not measured; Stage 2C's own artifacts record both mutations MATCHING where they had to DIVERGE, at both cuts it tried. Corrected in Stage 2D Addendum 2.
carried_state_finding.mechanism: a carried position's cluster and risk_dollars are read by exactly one thing — the cap gate, when a same-cluster candidate arrives WHILE that position is still open. Stage 2C placed its cuts to make the breaker's peak bind (a few sessions before the deepest drawdown), and at those instants no same-cluster candidate followed before the carried position exited. Measured directly at one such cut: both carried positions had ZERO same-cluster candidates before they exited.
carried_state_finding.equity_note: resetting equity to the account base only bites once the book has GROWN enough that the reset manufactures a drawdown crossing a breaker threshold; at an early cut it changes nothing
carried_state_finding.in_code: track1_bootstrap.binding_cuts() returns the instants where a carried position's cluster is consulted again, so the next mutation test picks a cut that CAN bind instead of hoping
carried_state_finding.counter_test: a companion test asserts that at the ordinary 2026-03-31 cut no carried position is consulted again, so if that changes the explanation goes red rather than becoming folklore
carried_state_finding.booked: remains a double-settlement counter and is correctly inert
